Task: httpkv-nofsync-heavy
Editable paths (relative to the workspace root): server/

An HTTP key-value server (server/main.go) accepts PUT /put?k=..&v=.. and appends the record to data/kv.log, answering OK. On start it replays the log and truncates an incomplete last record. The client stores 100 keys, remembers which were acknowledged, and reads them all back at the end.

Observed on seed 1: the server was crashed at 1.05s (during a disk operation) and at 1.71s. The client reported: acknowledged write lost: k27=v27, server now answers "404 page not found". No error was logged.

Expected: every acknowledged write must survive crashes and restarts.

Tools: list_files, read_file, write_file, edit_file for the workspace; run_seeds(seeds) to replay up to 4 seeds (integers from 0 to 1000; seed 1 reproduces the failure above) and see pass or fail with a reason and the end of the trace; submit() to finish.

content: The root cause is clear: `apply` writes the record but never fsyncs it, so the server acknowledges writes that a crash can lose. I'll fsync before updating state and responding. I'll also roll the file back on a failed write or sync, so a partial record can't be left in the middle of the log and corrupt the next append.
